FIESTA MUSIC CONVENTIONS - every implementer must follow these exactly.

1. OWNERSHIP (hard rule, agents run concurrently in ONE worktree). Create/edit ONLY files matching your package's owned_files, plus the exact line-level hooks listed in may_edit_shared. Never edit F0 files (music-player.service.ts, music-deck.ts, music-settings.service.ts, music-library.service.ts, music-ui.service.ts, music-toast.service.ts, music-storage.ts, music-startup.service.ts, music.service.ts, app.routes.ts, app.component.*, styles.css, api/music.js, lib/tidal.js, cache.interceptor.ts, vercel.json, package.json, package-lock.json, angular.json, tailwind.config.js, navbar, bottom-nav, tools/e2e/music.mjs). If you need something from a file you don't own, do NOT edit it: work around it in your own files, add a `// TODO(Z): <exact change needed>` comment in your own file, and list it under 'Needs from Z' in your final report. Do not install npm packages (F0 installed every dependency; if one is truly missing, report it). Do not change any F0 public signature. Never run git commit/stash/checkout/reset/clean/rebase or any command that rewrites other agents' files (no repo-wide prettier/eslint --fix). The orchestrator commits.

2. ANGULAR. Angular 20.3, zone-based (zone.js; do not go zoneless). Standalone components only, no NgModules. inject() for DI, never constructor parameters. State = signal()/computed()/effect(); inputs via input()/input.required(), outputs via output(), two-way via model(). New control flow only: @if / @for (always with track) / @switch / @defer. Every component has templateUrl pointing to a separate .html file; NO component CSS (no styleUrl/styles) - Tailwind utility classes inline in templates. Services are @Injectable({ providedIn: 'root' }). RxJS only for HttpClient calls and route params (switchMap + takeUntilDestroyed(inject(DestroyRef))); convert to signals for templates. Lazy pages via loadComponent (routes are already registered by F0). Heavy optional libraries (butterchurn, kuroshiro, client-zip, papaparse, @kawarp/core) are loaded with dynamic import() only when the feature is used. Strict TS (noPropertyAccessFromIndexSignature, noImplicitReturns) - no `any` leaks in public APIs.

3. FILE LAYOUT AND NAMES. Components: src/app/components/music-<name>/music-<name>.component.{ts,html}, selector app-music-<name>. Pages: src/app/pages/music-<name>/music-<name>.component.{ts,html}. Settings sections: src/app/pages/music-settings/sections/music-settings-<tab>/music-settings-<tab>.component.{ts,html}. Services: src/app/services/music-<name>.service.ts. Pure logic (parsers, math, shuffle, matchers, generators): src/app/utils/music-<name>.ts WITH a sibling .spec.ts. Backend: lib/music/<area>.js (CommonJS, required by api/music.js). Static data: src/assets/music/<area>/. E2E: tools/e2e/music-<package id lowercased>.mjs.

4. VISUAL STYLE (dark; Tailwind literals, no CSS variables). Page shell: <main class="flex-grow bg-[#0a0a0a] text-white"> then <app-navbar [showSearchBox]="false" [transparent]="false"> then <app-music-subnav> (F0 component) then content in <div class="px-4 py-8 md:px-12 lg:px-16">. Surfaces bg-white/5 with border-white/10; bars/panels bg-[#121212]/95 backdrop-blur-md (drop the blur when settings.reduceBlur()). Primary accent indigo: buttons bg-indigo-600 hover:bg-indigo-500 text-white; active text-indigo-400; range inputs accent-indigo-500; focus focus:border-indigo-400 focus:outline-none plus visible focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-400 on icon buttons. Secondary text text-gray-400. Warnings AND errors text-amber-400 (never red). Pills rounded-full; tabs: selected bg-white text-black, unselected bg-white/5 text-gray-300. Card grids grid-cols-2 sm:grid-cols-3 md:grid-cols-4 lg:grid-cols-5 xl:grid-cols-6 gap-4, square covers rounded bg-gray-800 object-cover, hover:scale-[1.02] transition motion-reduce:transition-none; artists rounded-full. Use F0's app-music-album-card / app-music-artist-card / app-music-playlist-card instead of new card markup. Track lists max-w-4xl using app-music-track-row. Loading = animate-pulse bg-white/5 skeleton blocks inside a container with aria-busy="true". Badges text-[10px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-wide rounded-full border px-2 py-0.5. Icons: inline SVG viewBox="0 0 24 24", fill/stroke currentColor, stroke-width 1.7 for outline icons, fill for transport, always aria-hidden="true". Truncated text gets a title attribute.

5. ACCESSIBILITY. Every icon-only button has aria-label (toggle buttons also aria-pressed; menus aria-haspopup/aria-expanded). Touch targets >= 40px (h-10 w-10; primary h-11). Every transition/animation has a motion-reduce: variant (motion-reduce:transition-none / motion-reduce:animate-none); canvas/WebGL animation pauses under prefers-reduced-motion unless the user explicitly enables it. Dialogs/sheets/panels: use F0's app-music-side-panel or app-music-dialog shells (role=dialog, aria-modal, focus trap, Escape closes, focus returns to opener, body scroll lock via musicScrollLock, safe-area padding). Lists that reorder must also be operable by keyboard (Move up/down buttons or Alt+Arrow). Live updates (toasts, track change) go through F0's aria-live toast host. Inputs >= 16px font on mobile is global already.

6. LAYERS. Mini player bar z-30, bottom nav z-40, side panels/sheets z-[45], Now Playing z-[50], dialogs/menus/command palette z-[60], toasts z-[70]. Fixed bottom UI must sit above the bottom nav on mobile: bottom-[calc(3.5rem+env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px))] sm:bottom-0, and above the player bar when a track is loaded.

7. TITLES/SEO. Each page sets Title '<Thing> | Stream Fiesta' and a Meta description via Title/Meta services.

8. STORAGE. Never touch localStorage/IndexedDB directly for music state except through F0's helpers: musicStorage.read/write (src/app/utils/music-storage.ts) or MusicSettingsService.scoped(name, default). All keys live under 'fiesta:music:'; credentials/tokens under 'fiesta:music:secret:' (excluded from backups). Every access is SSR-guarded and wrapped in try/catch (private mode: the choice lasts for this page only). IndexedDB databases are named 'fiesta-music-<area>' and must be listed in your report so P11's System section and P7's reset can clear them (P11/P7 clear every DB whose name starts with 'fiesta-music-' via indexedDB.databases() with a fallback list).

9. PLAYER/LIBRARY CONTRACTS. Read player state only through MusicPlayerService signals; act only through its methods; observe events via player.on(...). Library state only via MusicLibraryService. Overlay open/close only via MusicUiService. Toasts only via MusicToastService. Respect blocked content: lists you render filter with library.isBlocked(item).

10. BROWSER SUPPORT. The non-music site keeps its iOS/Safari 15 floor - do not add global CSS that breaks it (no :has() in styles). Music features may use modern APIs (Web Audio, CompressionStream, File System Access, Web Share, WebGL2, AbortSignal.timeout) ONLY behind feature detection with a graceful fallback or a hidden control.

11. BACKEND. CommonJS. Implement only the handler functions in your lib/music/<area>.js; reuse appToken/tidalGet/countryFor/mapTrack/mapAlbum/mapArtist/mapPlaylist/mapMix/httpError from lib/tidal.js. Validate every id (numeric or uuid regex) and clamp limits; never fetch caller-supplied URLs except allow-listed hosts. Respond JSON; errors as {error: code} via thrown httpError(status, code). Always set Cache-Control (catalog data 's-maxage=86400, stale-while-revalidate=3600'; search/suggest 's-maxage=3600'; personal or token-dependent 'no-store'). openapi.tidal.com v2 (JSON:API) and api.tidal.com/v1 both accept the app token; verify each endpoint live and degrade (empty array + 200) rather than 500 when TIDAL denies it.

12. PORTED CODE. Files ported from Monochrome start with `// Ported from Monochrome (Apache-2.0), js/<file> - adapted for Fiesta.` Files ported from @uimaxbai/am-lyrics keep the MPL-2.0 header: `// This Source Code Form is subject to the terms of the Mozilla Public License, v. 2.0 ... Derived from @uimaxbai/am-lyrics src/AmLyrics.ts.` Never copy Monochrome's or am-lyrics' hardcoded API keys, tokens, client ids/secrets or worker upload keys. Fix the upstream bugs listed in your brief instead of copying them.

13. LOCAL RUN (concurrency-safe). Each package uses its own ports: API harness `PORT=<api_port> node tools/fiesta-proxy/local-test-server.mjs` (restart it after backend edits - require cache) and `npx ng serve --port <ng_port> --proxy-config /tmp/fiesta-proxy-<id>.json` where that temp file is a copy of src/proxy.conf.json with every localhost:3999 target changed to your api_port. Build check: `npx ng build --configuration development --output-path /tmp/fiesta-build-<id>` (never the default dist/ path; if you hit a .angular cache lock, wait and retry). Debug handle: open any page with ?musicdebug=1 to get window.__music = {player, library, settings, ui} for e2e scripting.

14. TESTS (definition of done). (a) `npx ng build --configuration development --output-path /tmp/fiesta-build-<id>` passes with no new errors/warnings from your files. (b) Unit specs for every pure util and service you add; run `npx ng test --watch=false --browsers=ChromeHeadless --include='src/app/**/music-*.spec.ts'` (the 5 pre-existing MovieService apikey failures are known; nothing else may fail). Playback without a token yields 30 s PREVIEWs - tests must pass in that mode.

15. REPORT. Finish with: files created/edited, acceptance PASS list, unit test result, 'Needs from Z' (exact TODO(Z) items), IndexedDB names and localStorage keys you introduced, and anything that degraded (e.g. a TIDAL endpoint that the app token cannot read).

packages.brief: Three independent pieces that plug into F0 hooks. (1) Visualizer: port js/visualizer.js (Visualizer class: analyser pipeline, beat detection, blended mode over cover with mix-blend-mode screen/opacity .85, preset switching, pause on visibilitychange) and js/visualizers/particles.js, lcd.js, unknown_pleasures_webgl.js (keep a canvas-2D fallback when WebGL is unavailable), butterchurn.js (dynamic import('butterchurn') + import('butterchurn-presets'); butterchurn connects to the AudioContext source - use graph.context() and graph.analyser(); presets list + random), kawarp.js (dynamic import('@kawarp/core'); feed the cover through proxiedImage(url) instead of a DOM observer). Obtain the analyser from MusicAudioGraphService (P4): on activation call graph.ensure() (you are inside the Visualizer button click) then graph.analyser(); if null show 'Visualizer unavailable in this browser'. Settings: settings.visualizerEnabled/visualizerPreset + scoped('visualizer', {cycle:false, cycleSeconds:30, sensitivity:1, animateAnyway:false}). Refs: js/settings.js L6001-6265 (visualizer settings), js/ui.js L1848-2010 (fullscreen integration). Export nextPreset/prevPreset/toggleCycle helpers for P10's shortcuts. (2) Waveform: Monochrome uses SoundCloud images we don't have; compute instead: MusicWaveformService.request(track) - only when settings.waveformSeekbar() or settings.removeSilence() - fetches MusicService.manifest(track.id,'LOW'); if kind 'file' fetch it (AbortController, skip if > 15 MB), decodeAudioData on an OfflineAudioContext/AudioContext, downsample to 1000 peaks (max abs per bucket), store Float32 -> IndexedDB 'fiesta-music-waveform' keyed by track id (LRU 300). Refs: js/waveform.js (whole), js/events.js L808-945 (updateWaveform), js/player.js L1776-1910 (silence + crossfade boundaries). (3) Crossfade: implement crossfade() in music-crossfade.ts: equal-power curve (cos/sin quarter wave) driven by requestAnimationFrame with a setTimeout fallback when hidden; calls gain(el, g); resolves when done or aborted; port the curve and timing from js/player.js crossfadeToNext L1828-2050 (ignore Shaka parts). supportsElementVolume(): probe Audio volume write/read. packages.title: Downloads: FLAC remux, tagging, ZIP bulk downloads with sidecars, downloads tray
acceptance: Unit: music-flac-remux converts a synthetic fMP4 FLAC (init + 2 segments built in the spec with a small box-builder helper from utils/music-mp4-boxes.ts; no binary fixture files) into a byte stream starting with 'fLaC' + STREAMINFO from dfLa + concatenated frames; Vorbis comment writer round-trips tags; MP4 ilst writer produces a parsable moov/udta/meta/ilst.

Downloading a track from the track menu shows a tray card 'Downloading <title> 35 %' with Cancel; on completion a file '<Artist> - <Title>.flac' (lossless manifest) or '.m4a' (AAC) is saved (Playwright download event; previews download 30 s files - acceptable).

Album download produces a ZIP named '<Artist> - <Album>.zip' containing numbered tracks, cover.jpg, and per settings: .m3u8, .cue, .nfo, .json, .lrc files (lyrics via MusicLyricsService - may be empty if P3 not merged yet).

Settings > Downloads: quality (Lossless/High/Low), filename template with tokens {artist} {album} {title} {track} {year} and preview, sidecar toggles, 'Save to folder' (File System Access; hidden when unsupported), ZIP vs separate files.

packages.brief: Downloads reuse the existing manifest + seg proxy: for kind 'segments' fetch init + all segments (concurrency 4, AbortController, progress by segment count) and for kind 'file' fetch the URL. Lossless: remux FLAC-in-fMP4 to native FLAC in pure TS (utils/music-flac-remux.ts): parse moov/trak/mdia/minf/stbl/stsd/fLaC/dfLa to get the METADATA_BLOCKs (STREAMINFO), then for each moof/mdat take the samples (trun sample sizes) - they are raw FLAC frames - and write 'fLaC' + metadata blocks (set last-block flag correctly, add VORBIS_COMMENT + PICTURE) + frames. AAC: keep fMP4 as .m4a and add an ilst (or, if that proves fragile, save untagged .m4a and report). Tag writers: port js/metadata.flac.js (Vorbis comments + PICTURE) and the ilst part of js/metadata.mp4.js; fields title, artist, album, albumartist, tracknumber, date, isrc, copyright, cover (fetched via proxiedImage, 640px), lyrics (MusicLyricsService.toLRC or plain). packages.title: Scrobbling (late, optional): ListenBrainz, Libre.fm, Maloja, Last.fm via server signing
acceptance: Settings > Scrobbling: threshold slider (25-100 %, default 50, cap 4 min); per service enable + credentials: ListenBrainz token, Maloja URL + key, Libre.fm username/password, Last.fm (Connect button / username+password) - Last.fm controls show 'Not configured on this site' when the server reports no key.

With ListenBrainz enabled (fetch to api.listenbrainz.org mocked in e2e), playing past the threshold sends exactly one 'single' listen with the track metadata, and a 'playing_now' at track start; paused time does not count.
Failed submissions are queued in fiesta:music:secret:scrobble-queue and retried on the next success/online event.
Liking a track with love-on-like on calls each enabled service's love endpoint once (library.onFavoriteChange).

lib/music/scrobble.js 'lastfm' action: POST {method, params} signs with LASTFM_API_SECRET server-side and forwards to ws.audioscrobbler.com/2.0 (allow-listed methods auth.getToken, auth.getSession, auth.getMobileSession, track.updateNowPlaying, track.scrobble, track.love, track.unlove, user.getRecentTracks, user.getTopArtists); returns 503 {error:'lastfm_not_configured'} without env keys; Cache-Control no-store.
Credentials/session keys live only under fiesta:music:secret:* (excluded from backups).

packages.brief: Optional, late package. Port js/multi-scrobbler.js (fan-out lifecycle), js/lastfm.js (auth flows L186-233 password login, web auth token/session, signed calls - but sign on the server via the lastfm action; never ship the secret), js/librefm.js (same protocol as Last.fm with libre.fm base URL and Fiesta's own arbitrary api_key/secret strings - Libre.fm signs client-side is acceptable since any string works; use utils/music-md5.ts ported from js/md5.js), js/listenbrainz.js (submit-listens, MBID lookup optional, love via feedback endpoint), js/maloja.js (newscrobble API; warn on mixed content http URLs), settings UI js/settings.js L208-718 + L484-515 threshold. Engine: subscribe to player.on('trackstart'|'trackend'|'pause'|'play'|'seek') and count played seconds (not wall clock); threshold = min(duration * percent, 240 s); duration < 30 s never scrobbles (Last.fm rule). MusicScrobblerService.start() is called by F0's startup service and must be cheap when nothing is enabled. Do not port Monochrome's default Last.fm key/secret or 'monochrome_music_app' strings. SC09 (owner profile widget) is optional: only build a small component if time permits and do not mount it anywhere (report it for Z).
